title: STAR ARMADA binding registry v1
description: Maps a canonical gameplay identity to a visual asset manifest. This is the only place the renderer learns which model to draw for an entity: there is no per-model branch in the renderer and no filename convention is consulted.

station_faction.description: Explicit for stations: a station's owner faction is not implied by its class name.

identity.description: Identity is data. Convoy, squadron and station ownership must be stated, not inferred.

shared_source_with.description: Other bindings resolving to the same asset revision. Reuse is recorded, never disguised as a second generator.

status.description: Same vocabulary as art/manifests/model_inventory.json, so coverage can be built by joining the two.

legacy_identifiers.description: Pre-contract export identifiers this binding replaces (e.g. alliance_battleship). They exist so existing saves, replays and packaged exports resolve through the registry instead of requiring a save migration.

envelope_decision.description: The approval that covers this envelope's extent, when the extent was widened past the section 9 grace. It must name the decision the manifest's own approval carries: a wider hull cannot be accepted by silence.

assetId.description: Namespaced stable visual asset id: <ns>:<owner>/<name>. Never a gameplay entity id and never a translated display name.

safePath.description: Relative path inside the pack root. No absolute path, no '..' segment, no backslash, no drive letter.

bounds.description: Conservative visual envelope in the shared X beam / Y up / +Z forward frame, in catalogue world units. Presentation only: it must not change collision or gameplay size.

role.description: The six-role material contract. A new role is a new major schema version with a declared fallback, not an extra string here.

bindingKey.description: Canonical gameplay identity the renderer selects on: <faction>:<class-or-kind> (e.g. rebel:battleship). Stable ids only, never a display name.
